name: Evolved Sacred Silver
desc: Silvery liquid nestled in a chalice. Said to have been created by an alchemist, this fluid is brimming with mysterious power. While it supposedly grants beneficial properties to whatever it's being used to make, it's also incredibly difficult to handle.
